title: Cinematic Editorial / 电影感叙事
summary: One dramatic subject, restrained light, deliberate negative space and compact editorial typography.

dna.principle: Make a single recognizable subject the visual event; let a carefully controlled dark-to-light hierarchy carry a concise story.

composition.focal_strategy: One large focal subject anchored near a third; preserve face and silhouette
text_zones: Top or left negative-space band for an expressive headline
Quiet lower edge for limited supporting information
composition.negative_space: Reserve roughly one intentional uncluttered side
composition.depth: Distinct foreground subject with a subdued, atmospheric background

visual.lighting: Directional soft rim light, gentle falloff
visual.image_treatment: Preserve realistic subject proportions; mute surrounding distractions

typography.headline_style: High-contrast editorial display, few words, generous tracking when appropriate
typography.body_style: Quiet readable sans with moderate line height
typography.hierarchy: Hero first, headline second, details third

copywriting.headline_guideline: One short evocative line; no unsupported grand claims
copywriting.cta_guideline: Omit unless the purpose requires action

must: Maintain a single unmistakable visual hero
Make exact text readable against a reserved negative-space zone
Keep accent color limited to intentional focal details
prefer: Use tonal depth instead of extra ornaments
Create a clear headline-to-detail size difference
avoid: Crowding the frame with multiple competing decorations
Copying a source poster's distinctive full composition
Rebuilding the subject into an unrecognizable silhouette
adaptation: For a busy photo, simplify or soften the surrounding environment rather than crop important faces
For long copy, reduce texture and split into a clear title/detail system
For a narrow ratio, stack copy vertically below the focal image instead of squeezing it beside the subject

provenance.notes: Original illustrative starter genome; not learned from a third-party poster.
